title: world.refusals reads one registry across every door-owning assembly, the rule substrate included
binding: world.refusals reflects over one RefusalAttribute across seven anchored assemblies; a door whose enums live outside the composition root (Puck.World.Client's sdf.decode, Puck.State's state.rule.compile and state.rule.fire, the latter including the state core's own ArmUnbound arm, and Puck.State.Rules' state.transform) must not drop out, and a second attribute type would make the rule substrate invisible to the scan. The positive leg calls world.refusals and asserts the current census (186 across 12 doors) plus one member per out-of-root assembly; the discriminating leg never calls world.refusals, so the census text is absent there and the runner's cross-check proves the positive assertions are sensitive to it.

expect.name: a known SdfRefusal member is present
the rule compiler door is present
the rule firing door is present
the state core's own firing arm is present
the boot round-trips cleanly without ever asking for the census
